question: Which of the following statements is correct about mitochondria?

options.text: Mitochondria is present only in bacteria.
Mitochondria is present in all living cells.
Mitochondria is not bound by any membrane.
Mitochondria without outer membrane is called mitoplast.

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Mitochondria without outer membrane is called mitoplast**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mitochondria**__

 __
 
• All **eukaryotic cells have mitochondria**, which are **double membrane-bound organelles** that generate a**denosine triphosphate (ATP), the primary energy source required by the cell**.
 
• It is commonly known as the** "Powerhouse of the cell."**
 
• Both** plant and animal cells contain **the double-membraned, rod-shaped **mitochondria**.
 
• Its diameter varies from **0.5 to 1.0 micrometres**.
 
• The structure is made up of an **inner membrane, an outer membrane, cisternae, the intermembrane space and matrix**.
 
• The quantity of mitochondria **differs from cell to cell**.
 
• **RBC which is a type of living cell lacks mitochondria**, whereas liver cells have about 2000 per cell.
 
• In contrast to eukaryotes, **bacteria do not have membrane-bound organelles like mitochondria** or chloroplasts.
 
• Mitochondria without an **outer membrane are called mitoplast**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The mitochondria also perform **signaling, cellular differentiation, cell death, and maintenance of cell cycle growth**.
 
• Mitochondria have their **own genetic material**.
 
• The i**ntermembrane space serves as a barrier between the layers of proteins and phospholipids that make up the outer membrane and the inner membrane**.
 
• The mitochondrion's **outer membrane** is made up of** numerous unique proteins called porins and covers its surface**. 
 
• The** genome of human mitochondria** is **circular DNA**.
